title.official: Consequences of not filing third party statement of defence

variants.BOOK_A: Consequences of Not FilingThird Party Statement of Defence

division.heading: Actions Started by Statement of Claim

operative_text.controlling:
3.52(1)  If a third party defendant does not file a statement of
defence disputing the liability of the defendant to the plaintiff, the
third party defendant admits the validity of any judgment that the
plaintiff obtains against the defendant, whether obtained by
agreement or otherwise.
(2)  If a third party defendant does not file a statement of defence
disputing the third party defendant’s liability to the third party
plaintiff under the third party claim, the third party defendant
admits liability to the extent claimed in the third party claim.
